speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very strong confirmation from your specialist, yet the absence of fever and gastrointestinal symptoms makes Typhoid Fever an unlikely cause for your specific headache and visual symptoms. To ensure we are not missing a complication like meningitis or a neurological issue despite the lab results, could you tell me if you have experienced any neck stiffness, sensitivity to light, or changes in your mental status?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have any neck stiffness or sensitivity to light, and my mental status has remained clear. The only things I experience are those persistent throbbing headaches that are worst in the mornings and the intermittent flashing lights and blurriness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Migraine with Aura (with incidental positive Widal test unrelated to current neurological symptoms).
